verdict.rationale: Notion offers a generic REST API, webhooks, and integrations (e.g. Canva, Sketch) that let designers view/share design assets in Notion and could theoretically be used to sync status via custom automation, but there is no evidence of a built-in, native workflow where a design tool directly updates a Notion project status field without switching apps. Missing for 10: a documented direct integration (e.g. Figma/Canva plugin) that writes status/property updates back to Notion, and any hands-on confirmation that such a workflow works in practice.
